browse_component.description: The component that displays this page. Note: `main_app` is the main component that displays a list of items for example, it also includes app.dashlane.com. `dashlane_com` is only for dashane.com website, not one in which the user can log in. The `os_autofill` is for mobile autofill events (which are handled by the OS) and `webcard` covers Autofill events.

browse.description: Browse object. The page is only filled when landing on a new page, the origin_page is a reference to the last page triggered.
